3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Colour palette (editorial, muted, high-contrast for print) ──
REGION_COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia': '#DD8452',
    'Europe': '#4C72B0',
    'North America': '#55A868',
}
REGIONS = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
REGION_SHORT = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': 'Sub-Saharan\nAfrica',
    'South Asia': 'South\nAsia',
    'Europe': 'Europe',
    'North America': 'North\nAmerica',
}

# ── Global figure setup ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16), facecolor='#FAFAFA')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.88, bottom=0.06)

# Suptitle
fig.suptitle('The Global Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Inequality Across Four Dimensions',
             fontsize=19, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', y=0.96,
             fontfamily='sans-serif')
fig.text(0.5, 0.925, '2023 estimates  |  Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#666666', fontfamily='sans-serif')

def style_ax(ax, title, xlabel, ylabel):
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color='#222222', pad=12, loc='left')
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=11, color='#444444')
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=11, color='#444444')
    ax.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', labelsize=10)
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, color='#E0E0E0', linewidth=0.6, linestyle='-')
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel A: Income quintile slope chart (line plot)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
style_ax(ax1, 'A. Income Gradient', 'Income Quintile', 'Internet Penetration (%)')

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
quintiles = ['Q1 (Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Highest)']
quintile_labels = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
x_q = np.arange(len(quintiles))

for region in REGIONS:
    vals = [d['penetration'] for d in income_data if d['region'] == region]
    ax1.plot(x_q, vals, '-o', color=REGION_COLORS[region], linewidth=2.5,
             markersize=7, label=region, zorder=3)
    # Annotate gap for SSA and NA
    if region in ('Sub-Saharan Africa', 'North America'):
        ax1.annotate(f'{vals[-1] - vals[0]}pp gap',
                     xy=(4, vals[-1]), xytext=(4.15, vals[-1] - 4),
                     fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=REGION_COLORS[region],
                     ha='left', va='top')

ax1.set_xticks(x_q)
ax1.set_xticklabels(quintile_labels, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax1.set_yticks(range(0, 101, 20))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel B: Age group line chart
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
style_ax(ax2, 'B. Age Divide', 'Age Group', 'Internet Penetration (%)')

age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
age_groups = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']
x_a = np.arange(len(age_groups))

for region in REGIONS:
    vals = [d['penetration'] for d in age_data if d['region'] == region]
    ax2.plot(x_a, vals, '-s', color=REGION_COLORS[region], linewidth=2.5,
             markersize=6, label=region, zorder=3)
    # Annotate youth-elder gap
    gap = vals[0] - vals[-1]
    ax2.annotate(f'{gap}pp',
                 xy=(5, vals[-1]), xytext=(5.18, vals[-1]),
                 fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=REGION_COLORS[region],
                 ha='left', va='center')

ax2.set_xticks(x_a)
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=9.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.set_yticks(range(0, 101, 20))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel C: Urban-Rural paired bar chart
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
style_ax(ax3, 'C. Urban–Rural Gap', '', 'Internet Penetration (%)')

ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
x_ur = np.arange(len(REGIONS))
bar_w = 0.35

urban_vals = [next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data if d['region'] == r and d['setting'] == 'Urban') for r in REGIONS]
rural_vals = [next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data if d['region'] == r and d['setting'] == 'Rural') for r in REGIONS]

bars_u = ax3.bar(x_ur - bar_w/2, urban_vals, bar_w, label='Urban',
                  color=[REGION_COLORS[r] for r in REGIONS], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
bars_r = ax3.bar(x_ur + bar_w/2, rural_vals, bar_w, label='Rural',
                  color=[REGION_COLORS[r] for r in REGIONS], alpha=0.45, edgecolor='white',
                  linewidth=0.8, zorder=3, hatch='///')

for i, (u, r) in enumerate(zip(urban_vals, rural_vals)):
    gap = u - r
    ax3.annotate(f'−{gap}pp', xy=(i, r), xytext=(i, r - 6),
                 ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
    ax3.text(i - bar_w/2, u + 1.5, str(u), ha='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')
    ax3.text(i + bar_w/2, r + 1.5, str(r), ha='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#666666')

ax3.set_xticks(x_ur)
ax3.set_xticklabels([REGION_SHORT[r] for r in REGIONS], fontsize=9.5)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 108)
ax3.set_yticks(range(0, 101, 20))

# Custom legend for Urban/Rural
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#888888', label='Urban'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#888888', alpha=0.45, hatch='///', label='Rural')]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=10, frameon=False)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel D: Regional overview — horizontal diverging bars from 50%
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
style_ax(ax4, 'D. Regional Overview', 'Internet Penetration (%)', '')

overall_data = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']
regions_sorted = sorted(overall_data, key=lambda d: d['overall_penetration'])
y_pos = np.arange(len(regions_sorted))

for i, d in enumerate(regions_sorted):
    r = d['region']
    val = d['overall_penetration']
    pop = d['population_millions']
    users = d['internet_users_millions']
    bar = ax4.barh(i, val, color=REGION_COLORS[r], height=0.6, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
    ax4.text(val + 1.5, i, f'{val}%', va='center', ha='left', fontsize=11,
             fontweight='bold', color=REGION_COLORS[r])
    ax4.text(val + 1.5, i - 0.22, f'{users}M users / {pop}M pop.',
             va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8.5, color='#777777')

ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels([REGION_SHORT[d['region']] for d in regions_sorted], fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xlim(0, 115)
ax4.set_xticks(range(0, 101, 20))
ax4.xaxis.grid(True, color='#E0E0E0', linewidth=0.6)
ax4.yaxis.grid(False)

# ── Shared region legend (top-right, horizontal) ──
handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=REGION_COLORS[r], linewidth=3, label=r) for r in REGIONS]
fig.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper center', ncol=4, fontsize=11,
           frameon=False, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.905))

# ── Save ──
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, facecolor='#FAFAFA',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close()
print('Saved /app/output/result.png')
